title: China builds a cryo-electron microscope without imported core parts
summary: China unveiled the TH-F120C, its first domestically produced 120kV cryo-transmission electron microscope, in Guangzhou on 21 November. The instrument has an information resolution of 0.23 nanometres, runs control software on Huawei’s HarmonyOS and uses in-house field-emission, high-voltage, lens, camera and sample-handling components. Bioland Laboratory led the five-year project with Guangzhou Laboratory and the Guangzhou Institutes of Biomedicine and Health.
